title: 第1544章 法则本源反扑第1543章 直取本源核心
content_zh:
一半的法则本源彻底碎裂开，庞大的法则之力不受控制地浸染整个青天世界，如同一阵摧毁一切的暴风，海量的手眼通天消失不见，无数的物质生命，疯狂涌上，将昭光与吞天真君，以及成挚等八大宗全体成员裹挟住，法则之罚其余效果，增强数倍有余，剩下的另一半完全处于虚空污染而显得漆黑的另一半本源，像化成灰烬一般，少去一大半，不足原先二分之一，法则本源仍然在支撑着，世界的最终意志，岂能轻易妥协。
十柄利剑与相合的大海星辰继续突袭与淹没而上，无数的异能气浪相互消解，激起风云震荡。
十只参型全部被羽刃吸干生命力，化为干枯的干尸而死，洁白羽翼之下被深深困住的八位身受重伤的八大宗长老，受到昭光二人的力量波及而脱离困境。
七只法则之罚大手死死抓住的七个超级法器里面的全部天神一一从当中传送出来，剩余的最后一个治疗类型的超级法器玉壶犀角透支法器上的全部琼浆玉液为全体天神提供最后一次治疗。
成挚等人与无数脱离开八大超级法器的成员和其余众神，纷纷拼掷出还能使用的最强杀招，法则之罚的异能失效，门道紊乱，回收之手，令接近法则本源的全部天神，无法使用最强大的功法杀招，且即使正常使用其他杀招也会因为门道紊乱而自身受到重创，但没有一个天神退缩害怕，他们随着成挚等人爆发出勇往直前迎难而上的精神。
每一位天神的力量对比原先的自己不足五分之一，这就是法则之罚全部效果强化后的对天神们的极致的全方位削弱。
回手之手直接没收的天神们最强的手段，在法则本源面临被消灭的威胁，一并全部释放出来，这里就有成挚的破石穿空与大江东去，他的本命神通俱往矣遭受到禁用，既炎铉也是如此，更别说八位长老之外的其余天神，所有被禁用与夺走的手段。
无垠无限的力量，碰撞在一起，震荡轰鸣的声音不断，不停，它们形成无数奇异的色彩，将高天与大地相接在一起，令青天世界，爆发出一次又一次的异能狂潮。数万名天神，有的倒下，有的在继续前进，离开八大超级法器，也就意味着甲壳类生物脱下最坚固的外壳，失去外壳保护，身体极为脆弱，一般天神的身躯面对法则之罚的攻击，如同干草接触火焰，薄纸接触刀刃，会瞬间被切开点燃，毫无办法。
最后的法则核心，在昭光与吞天真君受到其他全部的天神助力之后，逐渐解体碎开，十柄利剑与星辰大海仿佛接触到这世间最为坚固坚硬的屏障，这层屏障还只是一层薄如蝉翼的蕴含全门道力量的虹膜，一如十只参型进攻本源核心时，核心所爆发出的防御威能，这一次的防御威能，远比上一次更加坚硬十分。
十只参型死去五六只，剩下四五只仍然呆有一口气，然而昭光与吞天真君并未将力量波及到它们那里，反而绕开了，这些参型在此前是多么的绝望与不甘，它们知道这群天神有一人会拯救他们，死是注定的，天神们与它们是死敌，然而如果天神能破灭法则之罚本源，它们也算是为主上无知己尽了最后一丝力量，完成了目标。
最后的法则本源上的裂痕越来越多，到后面只剩下一丝。
天神们拼尽全力，昭光与吞天真君也没有放弃，在万般艰难，在法则本源的负隅顽抗下，无法回头的信念，令那最后一丝的法则本源，被十柄利剑与星辰大海终于是彻底湮灭！！！
他们做到了！一众天神劫后余生，喜极而泣！
无知己死亡，法则之罚他们也扛了下来，胜利属于他们！！！
“无知己，这一次，终于轮到你输给我们了”昭光道。
“还好有运势上的眷顾，不可思议，师弟，我们做到了！”吞天真君感觉分外舒坦，以前那种被无知己所操控而无力的负重感，终于是在今日荡然无存了。
正当昭光二人传音询问应无悔是否完全掌握界外之力时，高天蔓延至大地的那条无限裂缝，依旧没有消失，这令全体天神都感觉到分外疑惑。
这时裂缝突然开始扩张，而昭光二人率先被拢入其中，随后是其他天神们，一股强烈的死亡气息在裂缝当中盛开，无形的压力，与无尽的全门道力量的湮灭，在他们全部天神上显现，那些死亡的天神，无一例外，从手脚到全身，像是被迅速拆掉零件一样，迅速消失，人间蒸发。
应无悔与琉璃等三人也被拉入其中，仍然存活的天神感到恐惧，他们朝裂缝之外疯狂飞去，只是裂缝不仅在收缩，而且即使距离外面世界最近的天神，他们无论多快，哪怕是瞬移闪现，也依旧会被困在裂缝当中，极大多数逃亡的天神，一般会直接蒸发在逃亡的路上。
法则本源虽然毁了，可世界的最终意志依然存在，它控制法则本源剩下的力量，要与他们同归于尽。

成挚等八位长老收拢全部成员与其他天神，燃烧自身寿命，动用只有八大宗长老还能修炼的功法，强行生成特殊超强防御罩——八极御，维持八极御会不断透支八位长老的寿命，且防御罩外若承受到其无法承受的攻击力量，会将部分转移到八位长老身上，继续维持八极御形态。
“八大宗的弟子们，莫要害怕惊惶，我们长老永远会挡在你们前面”成挚洪声道，随后它的嘴角就流出鲜血，身上本就不多的寿命迅速见底，不过成挚仍然是强装镇定。
“放心吧，小家伙们，我们这几个老家伙拼尽全力，不会让你们受到一丝伤害的”既炎的身体出现大小不一的扭曲，外界的攻势越发凶涌。
“长老们，我们同您一起！”
“我们一定能渡过难关，誓死扞卫八大宗！”
“这只是法则之罚即将消失的反扑，我们一定能挺过来的！”
……无数成员，爆发出震耳欲聋的振奋之声，他们相信长老们，也相信自己。
昭光与吞天真君勾肩搭背，他们表现出比所有人更加轻松的神情，“唉呀，哈哈哈，师弟虽然是赢是赢了，可这法则之罚的最后反扑，你师兄我也是无能为力啊”
“师兄，和你在一起联手作战的感觉真棒啊。还有再见面的机会吗？”昭光以应无悔为载体，在其身上还留下灵魂力量，还能够复活，应无悔有界外虚空保护，应该会在死之前比这法则之罚反扑的消失的前一刻领悟界外之道，从而保证自我不灭，如果未掌握，昭光那就是押错了人，一并死了也无所谓，而吞天真君受到吞噬界主一部分噬道本源赠予而复活，只是当这一部分噬道本源消耗殆尽时，吞天真君就会彻底消失。
“师弟，不要那么悲观嘛，那我们约定好下一个十万年再见吧，你这家伙肯定会说为什么要让你等这么久，呵呵，师兄我的人生足够圆满了，这不是给你时间，让你努力追上我嘛。”
“哈哈哈，那我还得多谢师兄你给我时间，我会尽量追上你的。”
昭光与吞天真君的身体极速消散，他们到了这时，依然在有说有笑，仿佛云淡风轻的什么也没有发生。
八大宗的八位长老逐渐力不从心，他们与昭光二人出现了同样的状况，所有天神的性命在这一刻岌岌可危。
梦幻般不切实际的场景出现，一处又一处梦境，覆盖掉幽暗冰冷的深渊裂缝，令它充满色彩，所有天神的紧张状态在此刻缓解，他们在此时仿佛看到了希望与奇迹。
这样的希望与奇迹，究竟来自何处？
content_en:
Half of the origins of the laws were completely shattered, and the huge power of laws permeated the entire world of Qingtian uncontrollably, like a storm that destroyed everything. Massive hands and eyes disappeared into the sky, and countless material lives surged up crazily, covering Zhaoguang, Tun Tianjun, and all members of the eight major sects such as Cheng Zhi. Holding it, the remaining effects of the punishment of the law are more than strengthened several times. The other half of the remaining origin, which is completely polluted by the void and appears dark, is like turning into ashes. It is less than half, less than one-half of the original one. The origin of the law is still supporting. How can the final will of the world be easily compromised.
The ten sharp swords and the aligned sea stars continued to attack and submerge upwards. Countless waves of supernatural energy dissolved each other, causing the storm to tremble.
All ten ginseng types were drained of their life force by the feather blades and turned into dry mummies and died. The eight seriously injured elders of the eight major sects who were deeply trapped under the white wings were affected by the power of Zhaoguang and the two and escaped from the predicament.
All the gods in the seven super magic weapons grasped by the Seven Laws of Punishment were teleported out one by one. The last remaining super magic weapon of healing type, the jade pot and rhinoceros horn, overdrawn all the fine jade and jade liquid on the magic weapon to provide the final treatment for all the gods.
Cheng Zhi and others, together with countless members and other gods who had escaped from the eight super magic weapons, all tried their best to use the strongest killing moves. The power of the punishment of the law failed, the doorways were disordered, and the hand of recycling made all the gods close to the source of the law unable to use the most powerful killing moves. Even if they used other killing moves normally, they would be severely damaged due to the chaos in the doorways. However, none of the gods flinched and feared. Along with Chengzhi and others, they burst out with the spirit of courage to face the difficulties.
The power of each god is less than one-fifth of his original self. This is the ultimate all-round weakening of the gods after all the effects of Law Punishment are strengthened.
The strongest means of the gods that were directly confiscated by the hand of the back hand were facing the threat of being eliminated at the origin of the law, and they were all released together. Here is Cheng Zhi's breaking stone through the sky and going to the east of the river. His natal magical powers were all banned, and the same was true for Yanxuan, not to mention the other gods except the eight elders, all of their means were banned and taken away.
The boundless and infinite power collided together, and the vibrating and roaring sounds continued. They formed countless strange colors, connecting the sky and the earth, causing the world of Qingtian to erupt with supernatural frenzy again and again. Tens of thousands of gods, some fell down, and some continued to move forward, leaving the eight super magic weapons, which means that the crustacean creatures took off the strongest shell, lost the protection of the shell, and the body was extremely fragile. Generally, the body of the gods faced the attack of the punishment of the law, just like hay touching the flame, or tissue touching the blade, it will be cut and ignited in an instant, and there is nothing you can do.
The final core of the law gradually disintegrated after Zhaoguang and Lord Tun Tianzhen received the help of all the other gods. The ten sharp swords and the sea of ​​stars seemed to be in contact with the strongest and hardest barrier in the world. This barrier was just a layer of iris as thin as cicada wings that contained the power of the entire sect. Just like the defensive power erupted by the core when the ten ginseng attacked the original core, this time the defensive power was far harder than the last time.
Five or six of the ten ginseng types died, and the remaining four or five were still breathing. However, Zhaoguang and Tuntianjun did not spread their power to them, but bypassed them. These ginseng types were so desperate and unwilling before. They knew that one of these gods would save them, and their death was doomed. The gods were mortal enemies of them. However, if the gods could destroy the source of the punishment of the law, they could be regarded as having exerted their last effort for the Lord and the selfless people, and completed the goal.
There are more and more cracks in the origin of the final law, until only a trace remains.
The gods tried their best, but Zhaoguang and Tun Tianzhen did not give up.With all the difficulties, under the stubborn resistance of the origin of the law, the belief that there was no turning back caused the last trace of the origin of the law to be completely annihilated by the ten sharp swords and the sea of ​​stars! ! !
They did it! All the gods survived the disaster and wept with joy!
No one dies, and they bear the punishment of the law. Victory belongs to them! ! !
"Wuji, this time, it's finally your turn to lose to us," Zhao Guang said.
"Fortunately, luck has favored me. It's unbelievable, junior brother, we did it!" Lord Tun Tiantian felt extremely comfortable. The previous feeling of being powerless due to being manipulated by no one was finally gone today.
Just when Zhaoguang and the two sent a message to ask Ying Wuhui whether he had fully mastered the power outside the world, the infinite crack spreading from the sky to the earth still did not disappear, which made all the gods feel extremely confused.
At this time, the crack suddenly began to expand, and the two Zhaoguang were the first to be drawn into it, followed by the other gods. A strong aura of death bloomed in the crack. Invisible pressure and the endless annihilation of the power of the whole sect appeared on all of their gods. Those dead gods, without exception, from their hands and feet to their whole bodies, disappeared quickly, as if their parts were quickly removed, and evaporated.
Ying Wugui, Liuli and three other people were also pulled into it. The surviving gods were frightened and they flew madly towards the outside of the crack. However, the cracks were not only shrinking, but even the gods closest to the outside world would still be trapped in the cracks no matter how fast they were, even if they teleported. Most of the fleeing gods would usually evaporate directly on the way to escape.
Although the origin of the law is destroyed, the ultimate will of the world still exists. It controls the remaining power of the origin of the law and wants to die with them.
Cheng Zhi and other eight elders gathered all the members and other gods, burned their own lifespan, and used the skills that only the eight elders could practice to forcibly generate a special super-powerful defensive shield - Bajiyu, which maintained the Bajiyu Association to continuously overdraw the lifespan of the eight elders, and if the defense shield received an attack force that it could not withstand, part of it would be transferred to the eight elders to continue to maintain the Bajiyu form.
"Disciples of the Eight Great Sects, don't be afraid, our elders will always stand in front of you," Cheng Zhi said loudly, and then blood flowed from the corners of its mouth, and its short lifespan quickly ran out, but Cheng Zhi still pretended to be calm.
"Don't worry, little guys, we old guys will try our best and won't let you get hurt at all." Jiyan's body showed distortions of varying sizes, and the external attacks became more and more fierce.
"Elders, we are with you!"
"We will definitely be able to overcome the difficulties and defend the Eight Great Sects to the death!"
"This is just a counterattack because the punishment of the law is about to disappear. We will definitely survive it!"
... Countless members burst out with deafening cheers. They believed in the elders and believed in themselves.
Zhaoguang and Lord Tun Tianzhen stood shoulder to shoulder, and they showed more relaxed expressions than anyone else, "Oh, hahaha, although junior brother has won, there is nothing you, senior brother, can do about the final counterattack of this law's punishment."
"Brother, it feels great to fight together with you. Is there any chance to meet again?" Zhaoguang used Ying Wuhui as a carrier, leaving soul power in his body, and he can be resurrected. Ying Wuhui is protected by the void outside the boundary, and should disappear before he dies before the punishment of this law. Understand the way outside the world, thereby ensuring self-immortality. If Zhaoguang does not master it, then he has bet on the wrong person, and it does not matter if he dies together. And Lord Tun Tian is resurrected by a part of the origin of the Way of Devouring from the Lord of the Devouring Realm, but when this part of the origin of the Way of Devouring is exhausted, Lord Tun Tian will disappear completely.
"Junior brother, don't be so pessimistic. Let's make an agreement to see you again in the next hundred thousand years. You guys will definitelyI will say why I have to wait for so long, haha, senior brother, my life is complete enough. Isn’t this giving you time to work hard to catch up with me? "
"Hahaha, then I have to thank you, senior brother, for giving me time. I will try my best to catch up with you. "
The bodies of Zhaoguang and Tun Tianzhenjun dissipated rapidly. At this moment, they were still talking and laughing, as if nothing had happened.
The eight elders of the Eight Great Sects gradually became unable to do what they wanted. They and Zhaoguang were in the same situation. The lives of all the gods were in danger at this moment.
Dreamlike and unrealistic scenes appeared, one after another, covering the dark and cold cracks of the abyss, filling it with color. The tension of all the gods was relieved at this moment, and they seemed to see hope and miracles at this time.
Where do such hopes and miracles come from?
